annotations.title: Equity research brief on one US-listed company (SEC filings)

description: Use when writing a stock thesis, an investment memo, a watchlist note or answering "is this company any good?". Up to 4 fiscal years of revenue, gross/operating/net margin, free cash flow, R&D, stock comp, buybacks and dividends; growth (YoY, CAGR, margin change, share-count change); latest quarter vs year-ago; balance sheet (cash, debt, net cash, current ratio, ROE); per-share figures; a 0-100 fundamental quality score with every component; bull, bear and watch points each quoting the number behind it; SEC filing links. Optional price= adds market cap, P/E, P/S, P/FCF, EV/Sales and yields. ticker = symbol, company name or CIK (default AAPL); about 1,850 US companies with revenue >= $750M or assets >= $10B. Not covered = error, not charged. No ratings or recommendations. PAID: $0.25 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/brief.

price.description: Optional current share price in USD; adds valuation multiples computed on the filed numbers

ticker.description: US ticker (AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B), company name or SEC CIK. Default AAPL
